{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING ISSUE: Missing step in funnel report (analytics/dashboards/funnel.py)

Common characteristics across all occasions:
- Component: analytics/dashboards/funnel.py (analytics side)
- Problem: missing step in the funnel report
- Reproduction: build the funnel for the two week window
- Signal: a stage with zero users between two populated ones
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/analytics/test_funnel.py

OCCASION 1 [2026-01-10]
- Context: occurred only on staging read replica
- Root cause: a cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR: #2030, branch fix/missing-step-1
- Measured outcome: memory settled at 868 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB

OCCASION 2 [2026-02-17]
- Context: occurred only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR: #3077, branch fix/missing-step-2
- Measured outcome: job finished in 49 minutes instead of 7 hours

OCCASION 3 [2026-04-09]
- Context: occurred only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR: #4679, branch fix/missing-step-3
- Measured outcome: error rate dropped from 4.5% to under 1 per ten thousand

OCCASION 4 [2026-07-25]
- Context: occurred only for sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR: #6389, branch fix/missing-step-4
- Measured outcome: p99 latency fell from 1.9 s to 687 ms"}
